trigger: first accepted inference request satisfying observation snapshot conditions; skipped busy observations cannot consume trigger
delay_location: IPC thread after complete packet receive, before result queue publication
timeout_clock: one second since result release to controller-side inbox; OLD clock never reset by pending FRESH
B0: pose at first recorded controller refresh at or after packet receive; require OLD valid there, otherwise insufficient evidence
B_delay: pose at first actual application of triggered FRESH; null if never applied
world_anchor: each prediction's own saved observation pose
old_execution_risk: observed OLD swept clearance below 0.02 m or corridor clearance <= 0 from packet receive through delayed switch or termination; boundary-straddling integration intervals conservatively included
classification_precedence: OLD_EXECUTION_RISK takes precedence, while both geometric classifications and FRESH full/prefix safety remain separate
unapplied: preserve received FRESH and report no actual delayed handoff; never manufacture switch pose
